name: Marvel's Wolverine: Digital Deluxe Edition
summary:
Unleash your full potential with the Marvel's Wolverine Digital Deluxe Edition. Look sharp with five exclusive suits and five exclusive claws, including signature looks from iconic Wolverine comics and new original collaborations with Marvel artists.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Marvel’s Wolverine
• 5 Exclusive Suits: Incredible, Savage, Night Hunt, New Leather, Age of Apocalypse
• 5 Exclusive Claws: Smooth-Edged Claws, Hollow Blade Claws, Serrated Spine Claws, Tapered Claws, Thick Claws
• 3 Technique Points
• Pre-Order Bonuses: Classic Brown Suit early unlock, Reflective Claws early unlock, 4 PlayStation Avatars
